_source: Transcribed from the published documents for SAQA qualification 121150,
Higher Occupational Certificate: Human Resource Management Administrator:
COMPLETE. All thirteen modules are transcribed to topics, topic elements
and, for the knowledge and practical modules, internal assessment criteria.
Work experience modules carry no criteria by design: they are evidenced by
a logbook signed by the workplace coach and accepted by an assessor.
Where the source document is internally inconsistent, the evident intent
has been followed and the discrepancy recorded here rather than silently
corrected. A moderator comparing this against the document will find these
differences, and each one is deliberate.
title: Higher Occupational Certificate: Human Resource Management Administrator
_componentWeights: The curriculum document states these percentages directly, under 'Summary
and Distribution of Credits'. They are not the credit split — credits give
35/35/30 — and the document is what a moderator checks against.
_exitLevelOutcomes: From the SAQA qualification document: the four Exit Level Outcomes and
their Associated Assessment Criteria. The EISA is set against these; the
IACs inside modules are what the provider assesses internally.

exitLevelOutcomes.description: Collect Human Resources data and process the data into appropriate information that is available for decision-making.
criteria: Use appropriate information technology to collect HRM data that is required for specific HRM tasks and processes.
Validate, analyse, and convert collected HRM data into information that is reported for HRM decision-making.
Prepare and present appropriate presentations at meetings, stakeholders and to diverse groups of decision-makers.
Maintain HRM databases, and extract appropriate information in response to specific authorised requests.

exitLevelOutcomes.description: Select and use appropriate methods, techniques, and procedures to provide professional administrative services for the full range of HRM processes and activities.
criteria: Provide administrative services for Workforce Planning in an ethical and legally compliant way that is aligned with HRM professional standards.
Provide administrative services for Staff Recruitment, Selection and Placement in an ethical and legally compliant way that is aligned with HRM professional standards.
Provide administrative services for Performance Management in an ethical and legally compliant way that is aligned with HRM professional standards.
Provide administrative services for employee Learning and Development in an ethical and legally compliant way that is aligned with HRM professional standards.
Provide administrative services for Grievance and Discipline Handling in an ethical and legally compliant way that is aligned with HRM professional standards.
Provide administrative services for Career Management in an ethical and legally compliant way that is aligned with HRM professional standards.
Provide administrative services for all Staff Separations in an ethical and legally compliant way that is aligned with HRM professional standards.

exitLevelOutcomes.description: Monitor, support and maintain the various communication and administrative processes with relevant stakeholders to optimise the employment relations in the organisation.
criteria: Update and maintain information systems relating to all HRM policies, procedures, and legislative requirements.
Maintain, update, and make accessible approved HRM policy guideline documents to relevant organisational stakeholders.
Maintain and make available records of regular and ad hoc employee meetings and forums to authorised persons in the organisation.
Receive, record and respond to employee queries relating to policies, procedures, and related employment contractual issues appropriately.
Official HRM communication channels are coordinated and maintained within the organisation.

exitLevelOutcomes.description: Access and use appropriate HRM systems and processes for the compilation, maintenance and safeguarding of all HRM records.
criteria: Compile and maintain HRM records, including personal employee records.
Control and manage access to information in employee and HRM records.
Archive and retrieve employee and HRM records effectively as needed.

_studyUnits: The provider's delivery structure, from STEP 1 - CA - 121150 - KM PM ELO
Alignment. Each study unit bundles the Knowledge, Practical and Work
Experience modules serving one Exit Level Outcome. Study Unit 1 serves
none: it is an introduction carrying credits but aligned to no ELO.

topics.title: Prepare and present reports at meetings and to stakeholders when required

elements.description: Execute the skill following specific processes.
Planning: Identify the purpose and audience of the report, determine the scope, and focus of the report, and gather all relevant information and data.
Data Collection: Collect and analyse data using appropriate tools and techniques, such as surveys, experiments, or observational studies.

Data Analysis: Clean and pre-process the data, perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify patterns and relationships in the data, and apply statistical analysis techniques to extract meaningful insights.

Writing the Report: Write an introduction that provides background information and sets the context for the report, write a methodology section that describes how the data was collected and processed, write a results section that presents the findings and insights generated from the data, and write a conclusion that summarizes the essential findings and makes recommendations based on the data.
Visualization: Use appropriate data visualization techniques, such as bar charts, line charts, scatter plots, and heatmaps, to effectively communicate insights and findings.
Editing and Proofreading: Review the report for clarity, accuracy, and completeness, and make any necessary revisions and edits.
Finalizing the Report: Ensure that the report meets all technical and format requirements, such as using proper citation styles and including an executive summary, table of contents, and appendix.

modules.title: Coordinate HRM Communication to Enhance Employment Relations

topics.title: Administer organisational communications

elements.description: Maintain updated filing system on all HRM policies, procedures, and legislative requirements.
Collate approved guideline documents for the implementation and management of HRM policies and procedures.
Coordinate and maintain records of regular and ad hoc employee meetings and forums.
Maintain a calendar of HRM activities and coordinate the scheduling of meetings and events.
Receive and respond to employee queries and questions relating to policies and procedures.
Receive and direct/escalate employee queries and questions regarding contractual and conditions of employment issues.
Produce and maintain official HRM newsletters and social media communication platforms (Such as Web Pages, Facebook Page, WhatsAPP groups)
Evaluate if the messages were heard and correctly understood and report.

Communication theories and best practices: A thorough understanding of different communication models, theories, and best practices, and how they apply to different organizational contexts and audiences. This includes knowledge of effective communication strategies, message design, and delivery, as well as other communication channels (e.g., email, intranet, face-to-face communication).

Internal and external stakeholders: Knowledge of the organization’s internal and external stakeholders, including e mployees, customers, shareholders, partners, and the media, and an understanding of their needs, expectations, and priorities with respect to communication.
Brand management: Knowledge of the organization's brand, including its values, mission, and messaging, and the ability to effectively communicate the brand to internal and external stakeholders.
Change management: Knowledge of change management principles and practices, and the ability to effectively communicate change initiatives and programs to employees and other stakeholders.

Crisis communication: Knowledge of crisis communication best practices and the ability to effectively manage and communicate through crises, ensuring that accurate and timely information is shared with internal and external stakeholders.

Digital communication: Knowledge of digital communication technologies, including social media, websites, and mobile applications, and the ability to effectively use these tools for organizational communication.

Data analysis and metrics: Knowledge of data analysis and metrics, and the ability to track and measure the effectiveness of organizational communication initiatives. Interpersonal and leadership skills: Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, includ ing the ability to build relationships and work effectively with employees, senior leaders, and other stakeholders, and the ability to effectively manage teams and projects.

modules.title: Compile, Maintain and ensure the Safeguarding of all HRM Records

topics.title: Act as custodian of HRM records

elements.description: Compile and maintain personal employee records.
Control access to information in employee records.
Control and maintain an employee record archive.
Receive, respond to, and escalate requests for information from personal employee records.
Labour laws and regulations: Knowledge of relevant labour laws and regulations,.

Human resources information systems (HRIS): Knowledge of HRIS technology, including how to use the system to store and manage employee records, as well as how to extract and analyse data from the system.
Data privacy and security: Knowledge of data privacy and security best practices, including how to protect employee personal and sensitive information.

Record retention and destruction policies: Knowledge of record retention and destruction policies, including how long to keep different types of employee records, and when and how to destroy or archive records that are no longer needed.

Documentation standards: Knowledge of best practices for documenting employee information, including how to standardize and organize employee records, and how to ensure that the information is accurate, complete, and up to date.

Data entry and management: Knowledge of how to accurately enter and manage employee information, including personal information, job information, salary information, and performance information, and how to ensure that the information is updated in a timely and accurate manner.

modules.title: HRM Data Collection and Data Management Processes
modules.purpose: To apply HRM data collection and management skills in a real workplace, guided by a workplace coach who signs off the logbook.

topics.title: Use appropriate information technology to collect required HRM data

elements.description: Receive coaching, training and orientation on the operation and use of organisation specific HRM information systems.
Execute a range of organisation specific tasks relating to the collection of HRM data using the databases or hard copy files available in the organisation.
Access and extract data from external sources where appropriate.

topics.title: Process data and produce accurate reports (regular reports and in response to ad hoc requests)

elements.description: Verify the accuracy and completeness of the data being processed.
Enter data into the appropriate HRM systems or databases.
Maintain the security and confidentiality of the data being processed.
Perform quality control checks to identify and correct errors in the processed data.
Generate reports and analyses of the processed data to inform HRM decision-making.

topics.title: Prepare and present reports at meetings and to stakeholders when required

elements.description: Identify the target audience and their information needs relating to the specific report.
Select the appropriate format, content and visual aids to effectively communicate the information.
Organise the report in a clear, logical and easy to understand manner.
Provide a summary of the main findings and recommendations.
Answer any questions or provide further clarification as needed to ensure understanding and actionability of the report.
Follow up to check that there was correct understanding of the communication.

topics.title: Maintain appropriate databases of information and extract reports in response to specific authorised requests

elements.description: Access the HRM databases according to laid down procedures.
Extract data to meet specific information requests.

modules.title: Administrative Processes for Full Range of HRM Services and Processes

topics.title: Provide administrative services for Workforce Planning

elements.description: Extract data relating to current workforce demographics.
Do basic website research relating to industry comparisons of employment demographics.
Respond to requests for HRM management for research and data collection relating to micro and macro environmental issues.
Extract historic employment trends and compare them with other organisation data where possible.

topics.title: Provide administrative services for Staff Recruitment, Selection and Placement

elements.description: Compile internal and external vacancy adverts using approved media.
Compare applications with the job specifications and request omitted information.
Prepare a candidate long list and submit for approval.
Coordinate and arrange logistics for testing and interviews.
Provide administrative services during the selection process.
Draft correspondence to successful and unsuccessful candidates.
Capture all required employee information on HRM system.
Update and maintain paper based and digital employee files.

topics.title: Provide administrative services for Performance Management

elements.description: Extract data as evidence of achievement or nonachievement of targets.
Update employee files relating to the outcomes of performance reviews.

topics.title: Provide administrative services for employee Learning and Development

elements.description: Schedule and coordinate training sessions and workshops.
Maintain training records and documenting employee participation and progress.
Providing administrative support for learning and development activities, such as tracking budgets and expenditures.
Prepare internal and external reports on L&D activities.
Assist in the controlling of and maintenance of training venues and resources.

topics.title: Provide administrative services for Grievance and Discipline Handling

elements.description: Maintain disciplinary and grievance records and documenting incidents and outcomes.
Schedule and coordinate disciplinary and grievance meetings between employees and supervisors.
Provide administrative support for disciplinary and grievance hearings, such as arranging meeting rooms and recording minutes.
Generate reports and analyses of disciplinary and grievance data to identify trends and make recommendations for improvement.

topics.title: Provide administrative services for Career Management

elements.description: Maintain employee career records and document career goals and aspirations.
Schedule and coordinating career development meetings between employees and supervisors.
Provide administrative support for career development activities, such as arranging mentoring and coaching sessions.
Evaluate the effectiveness of career development programs and making necessary improvements.

topics.title: Provide administrative services for Individual and Organisational Wellness initiatives

elements.description: Coordinate organisational wellness campaigns and events.
Extract and collect data on request to evaluate individual and organisational wellness.
Maintain employee records relating to wellness aspects.

topics.title: Provide administrative services for all Staff Separations

elements.description: Capture and analyse exit interview information.
Facilitate the release of documents to employees or their mandated representatives.
